definitions.force: 5ms average normal force, excludes friction; not instantaneous impact
definitions.hip_residual: left+right minus reference left+right; same -X axes
definitions.support_free: all foot/wheel and thigh/shank recorded ground forces below 1N, longest continuous interval in 1.20-1.90s
definitions.torque: actuator drive, excludes passive impact reaction

limitations: One seed, five complete cycles; no population success claim
Old matched training has no model_49999; matched comparison is at model_20000
Actual reference targets differ; lower tracking RMSE alone does not mean better jump
Current evaluation source recorded separately; saved training YAML proves parameter equivalence, not complete historical software/hardware equivalence
Loss of measured support does not quantify wheel collision gap; base/hip ground contacts are not measured
question: Does new wheel-to-leg reference improve motion with matched saved configuration and training iteration?
